candidates.exact_span:
The description, including procedures followed, and results of the Paint Filter Tests
          performed.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a reporting obligation for Paint Filter Test procedures and results; whether this requirement is actually applicable depends on interpreting the unstated parent condition for sub-items a–b, and non-numeric or absent test results affect how missing-evidence cases are classified.

candidates.exact_span: The description, including procedures followed, and results of the TCLP Test.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Requires reporting of TCLP procedures and results rather than a numeric effluent measurement; interpretation as report-only versus an enforceable compliance test, and whether the unstated parent condition triggers the obligation, changes limit-applicability classification, monitoring-obligation determination, and missing-evidence handling.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall report annually on the Discharge Monitoring Report the following information:
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets an annual DMR reporting cadence for the listed items; different readings of 'annually' (reporting period, due date, or Federal FY2025 overlap) change which monitoring periods are in scope, and absence of an expected annual report affects whether missing evidence is documented no-data, unmet obligation, or unresolved.

candidates.exact_span: Results of the Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure Test conducted on the sludge to be disposed (Pass/Fail).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies Pass/Fail reporting for TCLP on 'sludge to be disposed'; whether disposal is occurring, whether Pass/Fail constitutes an enforceable numeric limit comparison, and how to treat missing or non-numeric Pass/Fail results all change A/B/C outcomes.

candidates.exact_span: Annual sludge production in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Creates a quantitative annual reporting obligation for sludge production; interpretation of the reporting unit and annual period determines whether production monitoring was required and whether reported or missing production data satisfies that obligation.

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge disposed in a municipal solid waste landfill in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Conditions reporting on sludge disposed specifically in a municipal solid waste landfill; whether a facility's disposal pathway qualifies changes if this monitoring was required, and missing amounts may reflect no landfill disposal versus inadequate evidence.

candidates.exact_span: Amount of sludge transported interstate in dry metric tons/year.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Triggers reporting only when interstate transport occurs; interpreting whether transport is interstate or occurred in the evaluation period changes monitoring applicability and whether absent data means no transport or missing required evidence.

candidates.exact_span: A certification that sewage sludge meets the requirements in 40 CFR 258 concerning the quality of the sludge disposed in a municipal solid waste landfill unit shall be attached to the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Requires documentary certification tied to 40 CFR 258 quality requirements for MSW landfill disposal rather than a directly stated numeric permit limit; interpretation of what 40 CFR 258 requires, whether landfill disposal occurred, and whether an attached certification versus a numeric DMR entry satisfies compliance changes limit comparison, monitoring obligation, and missing-evidence classification.
